name: @asterixcapri/fondale
description: A web-native, TypeScript-first point-and-click adventure engine.

scripts.dev: npm run build:package && npm run package:example && vite --force
scripts.package:example: mkdir -p examples/capri-1535/vendor && npm pack --pack-destination examples/capri-1535/vendor && node tools/sync-example-package-lock.mjs && npm ci --prefix examples/capri-1535 --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.build: npm run build:package && npm run package:example && npm run typecheck && npm run verify:example-separation && npm run build:example && npm run verify:docs
